name: Forex GDELT hourly download and stage

nodes.name: Aggregate one closed hour of context

parameters.jsCode: const hash=require('crypto').createHash,x=$input.all();if(x.length!==4)throw Error('Expected four GDELT archives');const r=[];for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const b=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(i,'file_0'),j=x[i].json;r.push({observation_id:j.id,source_revision:j.rev,observed_at_utc:j.observed,available_at_utc:j.available,payload_sha256:'sha256:'+hash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex'),payload_path:'n8n://gdelt/'+j.rev})}return [{json:{stage_id:'gdelt-h1-'+x[0].json.hour.replace(/[-:T.]/g,'').slice(0,10),bucket_time_utc:x[0].json.hour,source_records:r,aggregate_sha256:r[0].payload_sha256,article_count:0,mean_tone:0,query_definition_version:'eurusd-context-terms.v1',uncertainty_label:'EXPERIMENTAL_CONTEXT_ONLY',retrieved_at_utc:new Date().toISOString()}}];

nodes.name: Persist provenance and stage hourly GDELT context

parameters.query: =WITH source_catalog AS (INSERT INTO forex.source_registry (source_id,contract_version,owner,license,cost_model,api_version,endpoint_allowlist,rate_limit,retention_rule,historical_depth,revision_support,timezone_policy,outage_policy,approval_status,secrets_reference,provenance_note) VALUES ('gdelt-sentiment-prototype','forex.gdelt-context.v1','Forex MVP','GDELT public data terms','FREE','GDELT v2',jsonb_build_array('https://data.gdeltproject.org/gdeltv2/'),'bounded hourly pull','hashes and aggregate only','archive-dependent','archive revision','UTC-normalised','skip; no automatic retry','PENDING_QUALIFICATION','NONE','Experimental aggregate context only; no article content retained') ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO NOTHING), source_rows AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.source_records) }}'::jsonb) AS source(observation_id text, source_revision text, observed_at_utc timestamptz, available_at_utc timestamptz, payload_sha256 text, payload_path text)), persisted_sources AS (INSERT INTO forex.raw_observation (observation_id,contract_version,source_id,source_revision,observed_at_utc,available_at_utc,retrieved_at_utc,timezone,payload_sha256,payload_path,redacted) SELECT observation_id,'forex.gdelt-context.v1','gdelt-sentiment-prototype',source_revision,observed_at_utc,available_at_utc,'{{ $json.retrieved_at_utc }}','UTC',payload_sha256,payload_path,true FROM source_rows ON CONFLICT (observation_id) DO NOTHING) INSERT INTO forex.gdelt_hourly_stage (stage_id,bucket_time_utc,source_records,aggregate_sha256,article_count,mean_tone,query_definition_version,uncertainty_label,retrieved_at_utc) VALUES ('{{ $json.stage_id }}','{{ $json.bucket_time_utc }}','{{ JSON.stringify($json.source_records) }}'::jsonb,'{{ $json.aggregate_sha256 }}',{{ $json.article_count }},{{ $json.mean_tone }},'{{ $json.query_definition_version }}','{{ $json.uncertainty_label }}','{{ $json.retrieved_at_utc }}') ON CONFLICT (stage_id) DO NOTHING;
